mask_policy: one independent Bernoulli keep decision per train-visible item per optimizer batch; shared by history/positive/negative; only ID lookup changes; no inverted scaling; eval disables masking
mask_randomness: dedicated Torch generator seeded training_seed + 31; ordinary dropout, shuffle and negative random streams remain separate
checkpoint_selection: unchanged: overall validation NDCG@10, then HR@10; earliest epoch on ties

variant_selection.primary: highest three-seed mean of cold Recall@500 and tail Recall@500, weighted equally
variant_selection.tie_break: smaller ID masking probability; retain the zero-mask control if no eligible improvement

content_channel: fixed mean of available observed-click raw81 vectors, exposure fallback; normalized query and item81 cosine; no new training

fusion.selection: largest cold/tail macro Recall@500, then smaller extra-channel quota; validation only
fusion.union_diagnostic: learned Top500 union content Top500 has at most 1000 candidates and must not be called Recall@500

evaluation_policy: validation-only development study on a previously reused validation cohort; never open new test labels, do not change the persisted original model/index
budget_caveat: same batch, epochs, train targets and 64 negatives per target across masking arms; ID mask adds augmentation work; machine timings are descriptive
